_about: The stadium builder: four stands, four corners, roofs, boxes and club-wide upgrades. Read by src/sim/career/stadium.ts. Money in Valmeran dollars; weeks are calendar weeks (pre-season and season). Every club owns a stadium; AI clubs build over the summer when they sell out and can afford it.

stands._about: Seats by stand level for a side stand (west, east). Ends (north, south) hold endScale of that. Level 0 is an open grass bank with standing room. Raising a level costs the seats it adds x costPerSeat for the new level, plus a flat fee, and takes weeks.
stands._aboutClosure: Work on a stand during the season closes this share of its seats until it is done. Summer and pre-season work closes nothing (there are no home matches).

corners._about: Corner infills join two stands. Level 1 needs both neighbours at stand level 2 or more; level 2 needs both at 3 or more.

roof._about: Per stand: 0 none, 1 cover over the back rows, 2 full cantilever roof. Cost scales with the stand's seats. Covered seats raise attendance (attendanceBonus x covered share of all seats) and keep the noise in.

boxes._about: Executive boxes in rows along a stand's back. A row needs the stand at level 2 or more (a second row at 3). Hospitality per home match = boxes x pricePerMatch x (0.5 + market) x occupancy; occupancy = base + perMarket x market + perMood x fan mood, clamped.

upgrades._about: Club-wide upgrades. cost[i] buys level i + 1 and weeks[i] is how long it takes. Effects by level are in each entry.

floodlights.name: Floodlights
floodlights.about: Brighter lights for evening TV slots. Adds TV money every season.

videoBoard.name: Video board
videoBoard.about: Replays and adverts. Lifts the shirt sponsor's value and keeps the fans happier.

signage.name: LED advertising
signage.about: Pitch-side and ring screens sell more advertising. Lifts sponsor money.

concourse.name: Concourses
concourse.about: Wider walkways, more kiosks and bars. More money from food and drink per fan, and a better day out.

shop.name: Club shop
shop.about: From a kiosk to a megastore. More merchandise money every season.

pitch.name: Pitch
pitch.about: Drainage, then a hybrid surface, then undersoil heating. A better pitch lifts the stadium's condition and draws bigger crowds.

condition._about: Stadium condition (0-1) feeds attendance. It wears down each season; a refurbishment costs perSeat x capacity and restores restore points, capped at max.

demand._about: How many people want to come, in seats. Starts at the club's original capacity, grows when fans are happy and the team wins, shrinks when they are not. Attendance share = engine share x demand / capacity (plus roof and board bonuses), clamped, so a bigger ground only fills if the demand is there.

projects._about: At most maxActive projects at once. A project paid for during the season can start now (closing seats) or wait for the summer. The summer adds summerWeeks of building before pre-season.

ai._about: Each summer an AI club whose crowds averaged at least fullShare of capacity, and whose cash covers the project cashMultiple times over, adds to its smallest stand (or a corner). It refurbishes when condition drops below refurbishBelow.

look._about: Free, instant branding choices. Seat schemes colour the seats; mow patterns cut the grass.
